sloka: ततः पावक संकाशैः हेम वज्र विभूषितैः ।जघन शेषम् तेजस्वी तस्य सैन्यस्य सायकैः ॥३-२६-२९॥
transliteration: tataḥ pāvaka saṁkāśaiḥ hema vajra vibhūṣitaiḥ ।jaghana śeṣam tejasvī tasya sainyasya sāyakaiḥ ॥3-26-29॥

translations.english: Powerful Rama thereafter slayed the remaining army with his weapons studded with gold and diamonds and glowing like fire.
